content.short: Tonnel Network is a zero-knowledge privacy project built on TON for private transfers and shielding flows.
content.description: Tonnel Network presents itself as the first zero-knowledge project built on the TON blockchain. Its public description focuses on privacy features for TON users, similar in purpose to mixer-style privacy systems on other chains, while using zero-knowledge techniques. The core value is transaction confidentiality rather than trading, staking, or portfolio tracking. Tonnel is the first Zero-Knowledge project built on the TON blockchain that aims to provide privacy features similar to those offered by on the Ethereum blockchain.
